definition.title: What is a virtual guestbook?
definition.body: A virtual guestbook is a browser-based app where wedding guests add photos, videos and wishes after scanning a QR code — no account and nothing to install. Everything lands in one gallery at original quality, and after the wedding you download it all in one go.

guestbookPage.heading: A virtual wedding guestbook — how it works and is it worth it?
guestbookPage.lead: A traditional guestbook has its charm, but it often ends up as a handful of signatures and a short "all the best". A virtual guestbook works differently: it collects real memories — photos, videos and messages from guests — exactly when they happen.
guestbookPage.whatIsBody: It is a page running in the browser that guests join through a link or a QR code. They can add a photo or video from their phone, write a message and browse the gallery of memories. Most importantly: nothing to install and no account to create. A guest scans the code with their camera and can start straight away.

1.title: You create the guestbook
1.description: You buy the guestbook (on its own or in the Gold package) and set it up for your wedding.

2.title: You get a QR code
2.description: Share the code with guests — on table cards, a poster at the entrance or on a screen.

3.title: Guests add content
3.description: During the wedding they upload photos, short videos and wishes straight from their phones.

4.title: You download the memories
4.description: After the wedding you download everything at the quality it was captured in.

guestbookPage.whyTitle: Why couples choose the online version

1.title: Photos from everyone, not just the photographer
1.description: Guests capture plenty of moments from the side: preparations, the dance floor, funny moments at the table. The gallery collects all of it in one place.

2.title: Everything happens immediately
2.description: You do not have to ask for photos after the wedding. Guests upload them during the party, while they are still fresh on their phones.

3.title: Easier for guests
3.description: A QR code and a browser are the lowest possible barrier — including for people who dislike installing apps.

4.title: Order and easy downloads
4.description: Instead of a dozen chats and cloud links you get one gallery you download in a single go.

guestbookPage.planTitle: How much does the guestbook cost?
guestbookPage.planBody: The guestbook is one app at one price, with no tiers to compare: photos and videos, the gallery, the guest page and QR table cards. If you also want save the date or the seating plan, the Gold package costs less than buying them separately.

1.question: Do guests need to create an account?
1.answer: No. A guest opens the QR code or link and can add a photo right away. There is no sign-up and no login.

2.question: Can we download everything after the wedding?
2.answer: Yes. You have {downloadDays} days after the wedding to download the photos and videos.

3.question: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
3.answer: Yes. All you need is a browser and a camera to scan the QR code — the guestbook opens like any other website.

timing.title: When to send a save the date?
timing.body: Ideally 6–12 months before the wedding. For a peak-season date, a wedding abroad or a long weekend, send it even earlier, because guests need to book time off and a place to stay.
timing.vsInvitation: A save the date only announces the date and place. Keep times, directions, the menu and RSVPs for the invitation you send closer to the day.

1.question: What is a save the date?
1.answer: A short wedding announcement sent before the invitation. It asks guests to keep the day free before they know all the details.

2.question: Do guests need to install anything?
2.answer: No. The save the date is a web page, so guests just tap the link on a phone or computer.

3.question: How much does a save the date cost?
3.answer: You can buy save the date on its own for {addonPrice}, or together with the other apps in the Gold package. One payment, no subscription.

4.question: Can we add our own music?
4.answer: Yes. Upload an MP3 or M4A file. It starts when a guest opens the announcement and can be muted at any time. Only use music you have the rights to.

5.question: Can we change it after sending the link?
5.answer: Yes. The link stays the same and guests always see the latest version.
